title: Our Quality and Environment Policy
heading: Our Quality and Environment Policy
body_html:
In infrastructure, superstructure, construction and contracting projects, the ADMINISTRATIVE SYSTEM POLICY OF METROTEKNİK and TEKNİK2011 is :

  • To ensure standards set by all relevant laws and regulations.
  • Compliance with the requirements of the customer legal regulations and the quality management system, under no circumstances, compromising on quality.
  • Reducing the use of natural resources and directing the use of recyclable materials as much as possible.
  • Wastes occurred during the service and other activities.
  • Considering environmental criteria while making investment decisions.
  • To be cautious in all our activities regarding the environmental impacts of these.
  • To develop a quality and environmental management system, to ensure that this system is effective and up-to-date.
  • Reduce Emergency Situations.
  • To ensure that all personnel is trained about environmental protection.
  • To fulfill all requirements of "ISO 9001-14001 Quality and Environmental Management System".
  • To advise and guide third parties involved in your business to implement environmental standards similar to our systems and to our suppliers and subcontractors that provide goods and services to our company.
  • In order to be a leader in quality and environment in our industry and to meet the needs and expectations of our customers; adhere to the quality and environmental management system requirements.
  • Continuous Improvement of our Quality and Environmental Management System, prevent pollution caused by the environment.
